name: H3 Extend SGLang
summary: Continues an existing clip through SGLang Ref2VA, using the tail as motion context and joining the new part after it.

inputs.label: Clip to extend
inputs.help: At least 2 seconds. The continuation is appended after this clip.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: The scene continues naturally: same people, place, light and camera style.
inputs.help: Describe what happens next. The last frames are used as the motion context.

inputs.label: New part (s)
inputs.help: Length of the generated part before the motion context is trimmed.

inputs.label: Motion context
inputs.help: Frames carried into the new clip. 39 frames is the community standard.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: Fewer steps run faster and look rougher.

notes: Draft: the SGLang extension adapter and source+continuation concat are planned. The standalone ComfyUI extension remains available.
